methodology: Compares RF held-out performance on the full labeled dataset against a subset of TOIs whose `toi_created` timestamp predates the Gaia EDR3 release (2020-12-03) -- these targets' initial TOI catalog entry could not have been informed by Gaia (E)DR3 astrometry/RUWE. Each subset is independently split 80/20 (same methodology, seed, and RF hyperparameters as train_and_serialize_model.py) and evaluated on its own held-out test fold, not a shared test set reused across subsets.
caveat: `tfopwg_disp` in this dataset snapshot reflects the CURRENT disposition value, not the disposition at the time of TOI creation -- a target created before Gaia EDR3 may have had its disposition revised afterward using Gaia data. This ablation measures a real but imperfect proxy for the leakage question, not a guarantee that pre-EDR3-created targets were never touched by Gaia-informed vetting. A clean-label holdout using only RV-mass-confirmed planets (attempted separately -- see leakage_rv_confirmed_report.json if present) is the stronger test the plan also asks for. See LIMITATIONS.md Section 1.1.
